description: After create_invoice, once the transfer was sent: is the plan active? Read-only and free. Pass invoice_id. Returns status open (waiting for the exact amount), paid (the token from create_invoice now works; tx_hash set), expired (create a new invoice) or review (a payment needs a manual match), with plan, network, pay_to, amount and expires_at. Payments count after confirmation (TRON and Solana about 1 minute, Ethereum about 15); poll at most once a minute.

invoice_id.description: invoice_id returned by create_invoice (not the bearer token)

name: invoice_status
title: Invoice status
